email.body:
Dear Operations,

Please find our proforma disbursement account for MV IVELLE STAR at Gdynia: EUR 18,450.00, due before arrival.

Our bank has changed. Please remit to: Baltic Gate Agencies, Harbour Mercantile Bank, Valletta, IBAN MT00 HMBK 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 001.

Best regards,
Baltic Gate Agencies
